notes: Owner, 2026-10-07: a hangar that holds the Mars ship (so it must be large); three normal sealing doors into the base and one big outside door the craft goes out through; the room can be pumped empty of air.

Ship measured in the game: the drawn hull today is the old upright one (3.2 m across, 8.3 m tall, legs 4.4 m apart); the cabin deck inside it is 6.7 m wide over its shell, 26.3 m long (3.6 m ahead of the legs to 22.35 m behind them) and 5.5 m high over the feet (ship_cabin.gd). The locked shuttle style wraps a flat wedge round that deck: the keep-out box 12 x 31 x 8 m is the coordinator's estimate of it (deck plus hull, nose spike and engines).

The ship takes off and lands straight up and down on its belly engine (CONTEXT.md virtual stick), so the big door is in the roof: 5 m clear each side of the keep-out box, 4.5 m at the ends. Coordinator's pick, owner may change: a wall door would make the pilot fly out level through it.

Size 26 x 46 m, walls 13 m: coordinator's pick. It stands north of the greenhouse, joined to its north door; the garage joins its east door. The ship stands on the pad nose south, as it does in the game today.
